content:
rachel-peopleops: Heads-up: collecting quick Qs about promotion communication, negotiation responses, and comp-change audit trails so we can update the FAQ. Drop examples or edge cases.

owen-engmgr: If an individual asks for the comp rationale after being promoted (they want numbers), what's our standard reply? Can we share peer ranges?

rachel-peopleops: We share the promoted individual's new comp and the band range, but not individual peer salaries. Suggested script: "Congrats again. Your new base is $X and falls in Band Y (range $A$B). We don't share other teammates' exact compensation, but we can explain leveling criteria and the factors used in the decision."

maya-ic: Follow-up: candidate internally negotiating a counter-offer after a promo offer was madedo we ever reopen the packet?

rachel-peopleops: We will consider a negotiation if there is new, documented scope or a competing external offer. Manager + director must submit a packet update with the new facts. Note: reopening is manual and rare.

simon-dir: What's the recordkeeping standard for negotiation docs and approvals? Legal asked how long we keep negotiation notes.

rachel-peopleops: Keep all promo packets + negotiation artifacts in Confluence Promotions archive for 7 years per retention policy. Tag entries with Workday action ID. If a negotiation involves external offer paperwork, redact personal info before archival and store the redacted copy.

payroll-bot: FYI: Archive retention policy link: https://confluence.redwood/policy/records-retention (Promotions = 7 years).

owen-engmgr: Are managers allowed to promise a "backdated" increase to match an earlier informal commitment? Say manager told IC in Jan they'd bump in Feb but paperwork missed the window.

rachel-peopleops: We avoid verbal commitments. If there was an informal promise, the manager should document it and submit an off-cycle packet citing the prior commitment. Retro pay is only approved if paperwork and approvals are completed before payroll cutoff for the retro month; otherwise the effective date is next month and Finance decides on any retro.

maya-ic: During calibration, is there a standard way to present cross-functional impact? I worry our product metrics don't show engineering impact well.

rachel-peopleops: Use outcome-oriented metrics and attribution notes. We like a short table in the packet: 
```
Metric | Time period | Contribution | Source link
Deliveries shipped | Q4 | Led infra changes enabling X | PR/Release notes link
Customer MTTI | Jan-Feb | Reduced MTTI by 30% | Datadog dashboard link
```
Provide links/screenshots for verification. If something is qualitative, include 3 peer quotes in the packet.

simon-dir: Can managers include customer testimonials or exec emails as evidence? Is that privileged?

rachel-peopleops: Yes, include customer/executive emails as evidence when relevant. If the email contains confidential info, redact as appropriate. We treat exec testimonials as high-value supporting evidence.

owen-engmgr: What triggers escalation to comp committee vs People Ops-led approval?

rachel-peopleops: Trigger points: >15% base increase, proposed base > band_max, off-cycle equity requests > standard refresh levels, or total cash + equity budget impact > $X (Finance threshold). Anything else goes through People Ops workflow and standard director sign-off.

maya-ic: Is there a public timeline for when the person will see the new comp in Workday after approval?

rachel-peopleops: Once final approvals submitted, Workday change typically appears within 3 business days. Payroll posting depends on payroll window; expect pay reflected by the effective month if cutoffs met. We send an approval email with the Workday action ID.

simon-dir: For audit purposes, do we need screenshots of manager approvals or is an email thread enough?

rachel-peopleops: Prefer screenshot or exported approval from Workday + manager signature in the packet. Email threads are acceptable as supplemental evidence but not a substitute.

payroll-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff calendar: https://confluence.redwood/payroll/cutoffs (use UTC times).

owen-engmgr: Edge case: internal move with a different comp currency (USD -> EUR). Who signs off on FX impacts?

rachel-peopleops: Include local payroll and Finance FX acknowledgement in the packet. People Ops will map the internal band to local band and record the conversion rate and date used. If there is potential material FX exposure, Head of Finance sign-off required.

maya-ic: One last Q: do off-cycle promotions affect headcount approvals? If I promote an IC into a manager role, do I need an additional headcount request?

rachel-peopleops: Promote-into-role that already exists as an open headcount just requires a headcount transfer in Workday. If the promotion creates a new management headcount, add an org/headcount request and ensure budget owner signs the packet.

owen-engmgr: Thanks that's helpful. I'll paste the manager script into my 1:1 template.

rachel-peopleops: Great I'll draft an FAQ update with these Qs and post it to the People Ops channel tomorrow. DM me any specific examples you want anonymized and included.
